source.title: ADIAS: Automated Design of Interactive Agentic Systems
source.repository_status: initial code release; current public scripts do not yet source-bind the paper's exact main 10-iteration experiment configuration

paper_protocol.selection: after T rounds select candidate with highest validation performance
paper_protocol.outer_evaluation: evaluate selected candidate on held-out test

mechanism.confirmed_fixed_rule: issue remains absent for at least 2 consecutive evaluations in reported experiments
mechanism.issue_guided_control: jointly selects target issues, parent agent and revision direction from current issue state
mechanism.focused_revision: applies a full-code patch to the selected parent while encouraging a small number of changed files

causal_interpretation.strongest_supported: Under the paper's matched 10-round/rollout protocol and held-out-test evaluation, using explicit issue state to actively control where to resume and how to revise materially outperforms candidate-centric parent policies that choose the best candidate or latest candidate while retaining candidate history and issue-profile context.
not_equivalent_to: a literal Stop vs Continue-fixed vs Widen vs Reopen four-way comparison
proof that diagnostic labels are correct
proof that all performance differences come only from parent selection; full issue-guided planning jointly changes target issue and revision direction
proof of generalization beyond the tested benchmarks/backbones

public_code_audit.readme: initial code release; formal run scripts exist under scripts/
public_code_audit.parent_selection_profile: current src/utils/gl_utils.py reads revision_plan.next_parent_genid from latest profile.json; if valid, uses that parent; otherwise falls back to latest
public_code_audit.best_parent: current select_parent(method='best') selects highest available val score, else train when no val split
public_code_audit.latest_parent: current select_parent(method='latest') returns newest archive candidate
public_code_audit.hard_collapse_guard: current code can override selection when newest train score is zero across all domains and revert to a prior nonzero ancestor
current_script_gap: scripts/run_taubench_return.sh defaults MAX_GENERATION=3 rather than paper main budget 10
scripts/run_alfworld.sh defaults MAX_GENERATION=1 and FINAL_TEST=0 rather than paper main 10-round held-out-test protocol
public_code_audit.provenance_status: mechanism implementation is publicly auditable, but current default scripts are not a paper-bound reproduction of the headline Table-3 protocol

frontier_update.new_question: Can repair-state control be separated into Stop / Continue-fixed / Widen / Reopen decisions under equal proposal/evaluation budget and untouched outer test?
frontier_update.why: ADIAS provides strong matched evidence that explicit repair-state control of parent+revision matters, but its ablations couple parent selection with issue-guided revision direction and do not isolate strategy reopening cadence or statistical promotion safety.
frontier_update.exact_next_action: Audit the public ADIAS release for a paper-bound commit/config, formal ablation launchers, test isolation, output/proposal chronology and result artifacts. If exact paper-run binding is absent, freeze the provenance gap. Then search for a same-system equal-budget Stop/Continue-fixed/Widen/Reopen experiment with a selection-unused outer test and audit candidate-local anytime-valid acceptance, restart-durable cross-proposal spending, immutable promotion identity, feedback bandwidth and complete chronology.
